attributes.name: Sentinel Devil
attributes.powers:
The Sentinel Devil is immune to Fire and Poison traits.

If the check to defeat does not have the Attack or Ranged trait, discard a card before your attempt the roll. 

If defeated, you may banish a barrier with the Curse trait displayed in front of a character at your location, and you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
